en-US.author: YeonGyu-Kim
en-US.description: AI coding assistant with read, bash, edit and write tools.
en-US.longDescription:
OmO is a standalone terminal AI coding agent with the OMO extension built in. It keeps a memory system, CodeMode and subscription providers, and lets one prompt drive several models at once.
It reads, edits and runs your code from the terminal, and works with Claude, Codex, Gemini, OpenAI and other compatible providers.
en-US.name: OmO (Baseline)

Release binaries may be up to 210 MiB. The 5.1.67 publish stopped on Linux x64 because its binary measured 209,889,456 bytes, 174,256 bytes over the 200 MiB per-binary budget (5.1.66's was 209,664,176). The budget moves to 210 MiB, about 5% above that size, and still fails any release that goes past it; the 5 MiB headroom warning is unchanged. (#13052) (#13052)
